seo.title: Tune Easy — Simple Guitar Tuner for iOS
seo.description: Tune your guitar, simply. Real-time pitch detection, reference tones, and haptic feedback. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: STANDARD TUNING
hero.title: Tune your guitar, simply.
text: A purpose-built tuner for guitarists. Real-time pitch detection, reference tones, haptic feedback. No fuss, just tune.

items.title: Standard Tuning
items.text: E A D G B E. That's it. No confusing menus, no alternate tunings to accidentally select. Just the tuning 99% of guitarists use 99% of the time.

items.title: Real-Time Pitch Detection
items.text: Advanced autocorrelation works great with guitar's rich harmonics. See exactly how many cents flat or sharp you are, instantly.

items.title: Reference Tones
items.text: Not sure what the string should sound like? Tap any string button to hear the target pitch. Learn to tune by ear.

items.title: Haptic Feedback
items.text: Feel when you nail it. A satisfying tap tells you the string is in tune — no need to stare at the screen while you adjust.

items.title: Clear Visual Feedback
items.text: Big, bold note display with a visual gauge showing flat, sharp, or in tune. Green glow when you hit it. Works great in any light.

items.title: Completely Offline
items.text: No servers, no cloud sync, no network requests. Your microphone is used only for tuning. Period.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Your microphone is used only for pitch detection. Nothing is recorded or stored.

cta.title: Get in tune.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
